queries.result: First-party discovery found ANCFCC's online cadastral-plan request service, its El Jadida external-office listing, and an official cartographic catalogue listing El Jadida products. No public anonymous parcel viewer or feature API was exposed.

queries.result: First-party discovery found ANCFCC French and Arabic cadastre descriptions, the El Jadida cadastre/conservation contacts, and the official El Jadida urban-plan page. Direct requests currently return an ANCFCC maintenance/403 response; no parcel feature response was obtained.

discoveryMethod: first-party English and French/Arabic discovery plus bounded official-page inspection and ordinary HTTPS GET checks
sourceReview: ANCFCC is the Moroccan national cadastre and land-conservation authority. Its official network page identifies an El Jadida Conservation Foncière office and Cadastre office. Official product pages describe cadastral plans and reference maps in Lambert and state that cadastral data can be supplied in digital or analogue form. The official catalogue and urban-cartography page identify El Jadida cartographic products, but these are not an anonymous parcel feature service. The online cadastral-plan request page is an application workflow requiring personal/professional information, title number, CAPTCHA, phone/SMS verification and payment; it was not used for parcel lookup.

attemptsRecorded.outcome: Official ANCFCC cadastral-plan request route was discovered. Direct GET returned 403 and the returned HTML stated that the portal is under maintenance. The indexed form requires title/cadastre information plus personal data, CAPTCHA, phone/SMS and payment; no request was submitted.

Official ANCFCC external-office listing was discovered. It identifies El Jadida Conservation Foncière and Cadastre offices and their public office contacts. No map/API configuration or parcel geometry was exposed.

Official French cadastral-products page was discovered through first-party search. Direct GET returned 403. Indexed official content describes cadastral plans/reference maps and Lambert linkage, but no public feature endpoint or field schema.
Official Arabic cadastral-products page was discovered. Direct GET returned 403. Indexed official content describes the cadastral plan and reference map; no anonymous parcel response was available.
Official urban-cartography page was discovered. Direct GET returned 403. Indexed content identifies an El Jadida public urban plan at 1:15,000; this is generalized cartography, not parcel geometry.

Official ANCFCC cartographic catalogue was discovered. Direct GET returned 403. Indexed content lists El Jadida products (1:10,000, 2015; 1:15,000, 2016), with no parcel feature schema or polygon response.

Not executed because the only discovered route is a maintenance-blocked application form requiring unsafe/personal fields, CAPTCHA, SMS and payment. No exact-point parcel hit or miss was inferred from this non-queryable route.
